class A:
 def __init__(self): self.saved=[7]
 def read(self):
  print("get")
  return self.saved
 def write(self,value):
  print("set")
  self.saved=value
  return [99]
 def remove(self):
  print("delete")
  self.saved=[0]
  return [99]
p=property(A.read,A.write,A.remove)
a=A()
r=p.__get__(a)
print(r is a.saved,r[0])

def callback(obj):
 print("body")
 raise ValueError("original")
p=property(callback)
p.__get__([7])

def callback(obj,value):
 print("body")
 raise ValueError("original")
p=property(None,callback)
p.__set__([7],[8])

def callback(obj):
 print("body")
 raise ValueError("original")
p=property(None,None,callback)
p.__delete__([7])

class Callback:
 def __call__(self,obj,*args):
  print(type(obj).__name__,len(args))
  return [7]
c=Callback()
p=property(c,c,c)
print(p.__get__([1])[0],p.__set__([2],[3]),p.__delete__([4]))

def callback(obj,*args):
 print("iterated")
 yield obj
p=property(callback,callback,callback)
g=p.__get__([7])
print(p.__set__([8],[9]),p.__delete__([0]))
print(next(g)[0])

p=property()
print(p.__get__(None,7) is p)

p=property(lambda obj: obj)
for name in ["__get__","__set__","__delete__"]:
 u=getattr(property,name)
 b=getattr(p,name)
 print(type(u).__name__,u.__name__,u.__qualname__,u is getattr(property,name))
 print(type(b).__name__,b.__name__,b.__qualname__,b.__self__ is p,hasattr(b,"__func__"),b==getattr(p,name))
print(p.__class__ is property)
